tasks.label: FindFinalizeProcess
tasks.command: $p = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like '*04b_finalize_sequence_viability.py*' }; if ($p) { $p | Select-Object ProcessId,CommandLine | Format-List | Out-String | Write-Output } else { Write-Output 'NONE' }

tasks.label: KillFinalizeProcesses
tasks.command: $targets = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like '*04b_finalize_sequence_viability.py*' -and $_.ProcessId -ne $PID }; if ($targets) { $ids = $targets.ProcessId; Stop-Process -Id $ids -Force; Write-Output ("KILLED=" + ($ids -join ',')) } else { Write-Output 'KILLED=NONE' }

tasks.label: KillFinalizeProcesses2
tasks.command: $targets = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like '*04b_finalize_sequence_viability.py*' -and $_.ProcessId -ne $PID }; if ($targets) { $ids = @($targets.ProcessId); Stop-Process -Id $ids -Force; Write-Output $ids.Count } else { Write-Output 0 }

tasks.label: FindFinalizeProcessAgain
tasks.command: $p = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like '*04b_finalize_sequence_viability.py*' }; if ($p) { $p | Select-Object ProcessId,CommandLine | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String | Write-Output } else { Write-Output 'NONE' }
